response.summary: The packet is internally coherent on issue/phase counts (twelve issues across F1-F8, nine accepted dispositions plus three tracked partials #297/#302/#305) and is candid about what it does not claim. Six problems nonetheless bear on the delegated close: the approved-plan digest cited by the close does not match the supplied plan bytes, whose r3 rulings relax the plan's zero-core-cycle gate; two surviving behaviors (#307 malformed-ID divergence between the emitted runtime and GND, #303 retained refusal) are recorded without owner, trigger or tracking issue even though neither is one of the three tracked partials; #301's new strict non-finite refusal is a changed public behavior with no migration story and no cited controls; the last independent verdict for six of eight phases was a change request whose repairs were never re-reviewed; and the r2 amendment's mandatory MIME variance experiment and validator error inventory are not recorded. A further eight hardening items concern unreconciled counts (#305 rows, F4 314 to 127), plan-required F3 cold-import/layer evidence, F5 v6 and changed-contract-byte controls, F2's undefined "four owed rows", unreviewed post-integration repairs, F7 counts not bound to the regenerated TSV, and the unevidenced per-phase refactoring review.

response.summary: All three artifacts hash to the requested digests. Twelve issue dispositions reconcile across eight linked phase records (nine accepted, three tracked partials), each residual names an owner and a trigger, the r3 amendments record every supersession of the r2 exit criteria (F3 membership limit, F4 refusal order, F5 dual formats, F6 admitted domain, F7 deferred removals), and the approved-plan digest e41991f2 matches the recorded plan gate. The close also candidly separates independent review of presented versions from post-review repairs. Four advisory concerns remain, none of which contradicts the delegated close itself.

criteria: Assess whether the twelve issue dispositions and eight phase records support the proposed delegated close. Prioritize material contradictions, missing gates or residuals without owners or triggers.
Evaluate the scope of the compatibility, portability and test claims against the measured results. Distinguish phase review, reviewed versions, repairs, and the owner ruling. Cite the specific text.
Review the three supplied artifacts as a focused pass. Do not run builds or tests, change files, or delegate.
